mission.title: Miracle Drug
mission.description: Test Flood's synthesized cheat code drug on a Blackwood.

npc.say: Hm... I suppose you wouldn't want to get it close to any of your own mucous membranes, however.

Gosh, I hadn't noticed before, but I could sure use a haircut. Hm... If I had a mirror, I could probably just burn it off with my laser vision.
Do you think you could bring me a mirror? Hey, where are you going?
No, we haven't checked on the subject. I avoid looking at the lower species whenever possible.
Several Blackwoods attempted to force their way in. They were...somewhat stringy, but filling. There have been no more attempts since then.

phase.briefing:
Operative, have I ever mentioned that I find the very sound of your voice irritating? Oh, I don't blame you for it; after all, you can't help how you were made.
You'll be overwhelmed with joy to know that we have successfully produced a batch of our own cheat codes based off of the Unlimit we captured--the love-sick Beirn. It has been compiled into drug form for ease of distribution.
However, it has yet to be tested. Since you failed in your last attempt at testing a cheat code, in my mighty benevolence I am giving you another chance. Collect the test drug from our technician, Christel Runnels.

enter.say: Maybe you can save a little of the drug to slip into Flood's mimosa when he isn't looking.

talk.say: Ah, Flood's envoy. I'm happy to tell you that in this form, the cheat code is quite stable, and you should be able to take it anywhere in perfect safety.

done.say: I love how working for Flood makes me feel like a crack dealer. Oh well, I suppose these sacrifices must be made. Get the drugs from Christel Runnels.

objective.text: Get the drugs from Christel Runnels

talk.say: You're fully authorized to accept these from me.

done.say: Off we go! But if Flood sends us to an elementary school, I'm going to file a formal protest.

phase.briefing:
Now we have only to choose a test subject... I think we want a program. Let me see... Ookami? No, might sour her disposition even more. A blood-drinker? Mmm, no--too old-fashioned. A Crusher? No, they're already ugly enough... A Blackwood? Hm, why not?
Very well. Go find a Blackwood, and give them the drug--by force, if necessary. Make sure you get them alone; if there are more than one, kill the rest before administering the cheat code. Then report back to me.
Oh, I can just imagine the stupid look of confusion on your face. Where to find a Blackwood? They're around Mara, of course. Here, I'll give you a pointer. Now, get moving.

enter.say: I'm reading some Exile programs in there. If they're Blackwoods, remember to take out all but one of them.

objective.text: Kill all but one of the Blackwoods
Give the drug to the last Blackwood

done.say: I'm reading some alterations in his code, but it's hard to tell what's going on with it. At least it's having some effect this time. I guess we'd better report back to Flood.

phase.briefing:
I seem to have underestimated the popularity of this code among the unwashed masses. The news of the "miracle drug" has already spread like wildfire through the puny Blackwood community; you forgot to take his cell phone away from him, didn't you?
You've got a bit of a mess to clean up, operative. A pack of the Blackwoods are massing nearby, no doubt planning to rip our test subject to pieces and drink his blood, or something equally primitive. Why don't you show them who does the ripping?

enter.say: You know, I kind of miss the old days when the Blackwoods actually posed a threat to you; remember when Mara seemed like dangerous new territory? Ah, memories...

done.say: Just like the good old days, eh, buddy?

phase.briefing:
I'm glad to see you've crushed that pygmy rebellion, {player}; I knew those runts were right up your alley.
Now then, it's just about time for you to check on your test subject. If their looks haven't improved, I will be...vexed. And you don't want that, do you?

enter.say:
How about a little wager? I bet he's now madly in love with Persephone!
What? This is not a trick bet! Who says all guys are already in love with her? That's totally not true. So do we have a bet, or not?

talk.say:
I'm doing good! I still feel a little woozy...but I'm sure to be up and flying around in no time!
What? What are you looking at? Do I have a big zit on my face? It is feeling a little pinched.

done.say:
Yeesh! What are we gonna call that guy now? The "Blackweena"?
Although... I think I know some guys who might want a pinch of that stuff, if you have any left...

near.say:
Dude!
...Or not, as the case may be.

mission.finish:
I heard your tittering, operative, and I can tell you that there is nothing amusing about this situation in the slightest. Frankly, I find your lack of composure appalling, as well as your second failure in testing cheat codes. I'm not at all sure why I trust you with these assignments.
Clearly, some adjustments will have to be made.
